title: Sprint 1 — MongoDB Foundations
description: Understand what MongoDB is, set up the shell, and perform basic CRUD operations.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Introduction to MongoDB
tickets.description:
Explore the Mongo shell.
Create your first collection and document.
Understand documents vs rows.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.1 — Explore the MongoDB Shell
tasks.description: Explore the MongoDB shell by checking available databases, switching to a new working database, and verifying database statistics and version information.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.2 — Create Your First Collection & Document
tasks.description: Create a new 'students' collection and insert your first document containing basic student information.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.3 — Understand Documents vs Rows
tasks.description: Query a collection to understand the flexible schema of documents, and practice retrieving all documents, single documents, and specific fields.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — CRUD Operations
tickets.description:
Insert documents with insertOne and insertMany.
Read documents with filters.
Update documents.
Delete documents.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.1 — insertOne & insertMany
tasks.description: Insert a single book and multiple books into a collection using the appropriate insertion commands.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.2 — Read with Filters
tasks.description: Query for documents using specific filters, such as finding employees in a certain department or with a salary above a threshold.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.3 — Update Operations
tasks.description: Update specific fields in a document and apply updates to multiple documents simultaneously using update operators.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.4 — Delete Operations
tasks.description: Remove single and multiple documents from a collection based on specific conditions, and learn how to drop an entire collection.
